text:
alex: Heads-up — trying to implement a header-driven fallback routing so customers can force a degraded model for A/B tests. Current idea: `X-RW-Fallback: backup-model=redwood-small;reason=test`. Thoughts?

meera: header override seems reasonable. two immediate caveats: 1) auth/permissions (who can set this), 2) telemetry & billing impact (we need to tag requests so metrics and invoices are accurate).

jonathan: agree. also need deterministic interaction with circuit breakers. proposal: if primary returns 5 consecutive 429/5xx within 60s, flip to fallback_chain automatically and emit `fallback_reason=circuit`. we should include reason codes for manual/quota/circuit.

olivia: sketch of policy snippet for discussion:

```
match:
  path: /v1/generate
  headers:
    x-rw-fallback: present
actions:
  route:
    primary: redwood-xxl
    fallback_chain:
      - model: redwood-medium
        trigger: circuit_breaker(5,60s)
      - model: redwood-small
        trigger: capacity_burst
    annotate_header: X-RW-Fallback-Path
```

maya: looks good. two notes: 1) `annotate_header` should be internal-only to avoid leaking routing internals to customers, maybe `X-RW-Fallback-Tag`. 2) when fallback is manual via header, do not count it as a circuit-triggered incident in incident dashboards.

jonathan: +1 on internal header. also we should propagate a short reason code and model id in traces/spans so the console can filter by `fallback_reason`. add metrics: `fallback_activated_total{route,model,reason}` and `fallback_latency_ms_bucket` per model.

alex: good. on billing: if fallback is due to quota (rate limit hit) vs manual, billing treatment differs. add `billing_tag` to requests when fallback is active so cost attribution is correct.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: `gateway/routing v2` -> canary 3/10 nodes @ 2026-03-15T14:12Z :rocket:

meera: small implementation nit: when we switch models mid-request (rare), ensure KV cache invalidation or at least prefix-tagging to avoid cache collisions between model variants. also check tokenizer compatibility across fallback models.

olivia: can we add an admin override endpoint (`POST /internal/v1/route/override`) to force a route into a fallback chain for incidents & runbooks? would be useful for SRE to mitigate noisy primaries quickly.

alex: yes — plan: 1) update policy schema (allow header match + fallback_chain + annotate/internal flags), 2) instrumentation PR for metrics and trace annotations, 3) console change: per-route fallback rate + reason pie + model-level latency breakdown, 4) admin override endpoint with audit logging. I'll open PRs and ping infra.

maya: quick UX ask: in rollouts UI show active fallback rate and an option to "auto-fallback if latency > X" with a suggested default. keeps things discoverable for non-engineering PMs. :eyes:

jonathan: one more: set a max fallback depth (2-3 models) and a global guard to avoid endless oscillation between models. add hysteresis to circuit breaker (cooldown window).

alex: all good. I'll draft the PRs. tagging @meera @jonathan @olivia for review. :thumbsup:
